## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: name and address changes, records, legal presence and the road test
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from this section's selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge or memory.
The fee lines on the first selected page are printed as a list without a heading for every row; only the abandoned vehicle and returned check fees and the reinstatement rule were used [A01].
The tips list wraps across columns in the extracted text; each tip was used only where its wording was unambiguous [A01].
The military paragraph points to the MVD website for a five-year license option without describing it, so that option is not taught (verify AZ-REC-D-MILITARY) [A02].
The legal-presence rule is restated from the statute reference printed on the page; the statute text itself was not consulted [A03].
Originality: every statement is reworded from the cited page; no manual sentence, table, image or official test question is reproduced.
Exam numbers: the manual prints no question count, passing score, item format or time limit, so none is stated anywhere in this section; the typed debts live in part A.
External review: restating published Arizona traffic and licensing rules needs no clinical or legal sign-off; none is requested.

corpus_stability.reason: The Arizona Driver License Manual carries one revision line on its contents page (Revised September 2026) and points to Arizona Revised Statutes Title 28 for current law; nothing in the selected pages signals more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: The manual refers military personnel to azdot.gov/mvd for a five-year driver license and vehicle services but gives no terms; confirm on the official MVD page before teaching any detail.
